name: Periglacial-Pediment
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around acid rain regions, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.

The terrain around the escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
